The '''Ark of Baron Auletphant''' was an interstellar [[Freighter/Legends|barge]]. It was [[Color/Legends|golden]] and was inlaid with rose and azure [[Mytag crystal/Legends|mytag crystals]]. Commissioned more than ten [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]] prior to [[520 BBY/Legends|520 BBY]], the Ark of Baron Auletphant traveled for a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] between far-flung [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. There, the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] collected specimens of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] life.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[10,000 BBY]], the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]] included the barge in the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]]&mdash;a list of spectactular, antique artificial objects compiled for the publication ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]''. The Ark of Baron Auletphant at one point became lost in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], remaining so for ten millennia. In 520 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the ship became housed in the [[Baobab Archives]] on<ref name="TEA" /> the planet<ref name="DroidsReanimated">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Manda/Legends|Manda]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Something about this idea appealed to me, that of a crazy Noah collecting fish from across the galaxy in his golden starship. I'd imagine that when the ark was rediscovered 10,000 years later the smell was terrible.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_24.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref>}}
The Ark of Baron Auletphant was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" /> Wallace noted in his personal blog that he particularly enjoyed creating names for those of the Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy that were original to the book, which included the Ark of Baron Auletphant. The author specifically created the vessel due to finding an appeal in the idea of a "crazy" individual collecting in his golden spaceship [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from various [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] locations. Wallace also quipped about the Ark of Baron Auletphant having a "terrible" smell after its rediscovery due to the decomposition of abovementioned aquatic life over the intervening thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Blog" />
